name: rg
description: Search file contents with ripgrep. Partial community schema covering text search and file listing; preprocessing, indexing, and replacement options are excluded. Configuration can add options with side effects, so mutation status is unknown. Examples disable configuration.

capabilities.name: <pattern> [path...]
capabilities.description: Search a regular expression in files or stdin. Hidden and ignored files are skipped by default.

args.name: path
args.description: One or more files or directories; use - for stdin.

args.name: --fixed-strings
args.description: Match literal text instead of a regular expression.

args.name: --glob
args.description: Include matching paths; a leading ! excludes them. Repeatable.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Matching text, or JSON events with --json; not a JSON array.

capabilities.name: --files [path...]
capabilities.description: List searchable files without inspecting their contents.

args.name: path
args.description: One or more directories; defaults to the current directory.

args.name: --glob
args.description: Filter paths with a glob. Repeatable.

args.name: --null
args.description: Terminate paths with NUL instead of a newline.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: File paths separated by newlines, or NUL with --null.
